intro: The Auraline Premium transforms clutter into calm. With dent-resistant steel, flexible storage and a biometric drawer lock, it’s crafted to safeguard your essentials while simplifying your lifestyle.

features.title: Made to last with durable steel construction
features.text: Built with dent-resistant steel, this almirah is designed to protect your belongings while standing strong through years of daily use.

features.title: Built-in biometric locker for valuables
features.text: A secure biometric locker offers peace of mind, letting you store jewellery, documents, or cash with the confidence of cutting-edge security.

features.title: Modern design with LED lighting
features.text: Equipped with motion-sensor LED lights, this almirah ensures you can easily access your belongings even in low-light conditions—perfect for busy mornings or late evenings.

features.title: Timeless finish with built in mirror
features.text: The rich finish adds sophistication to your interiors while the built-in full-length mirror not only saves space but also helps you get ready with ease, enhancing your everyday routine.

features.title: Hassle-free cleaning and upkeep
features.text: Cleaning is a breeze with the openable skirting, ensuring your almirah stays fresh and tidy without extra effort.

name: Auraline Men Premium 2-Door Steel Almirah With Mirror Textured Navy Blue
